name: Habsburg Livestock Colony
title: The Habsburg Monarchy (Livestock Colony)
pressure_shape: Town spread: Towns gathered into Build lands (L1), 2 Towns instead of an Inland City (L2), one fewer Stage I card (L3), Durable Towns in lands without Blight (L4), reminder-card wave (L5), +2 Ravage Damage next to Towns (L6); loses on Blight from 6+ overkill Ravages.

stage_ii_escalation.title: Seek Prime Territory
stage_ii_escalation.text: After Exploring: On each board with 4 or fewer Blight, add 1 Town to a land without Town/Blight. On each board with 2 or fewer Blight, do so again.

loss_condition.title: Irreparable Damage
loss_condition.text: Track how many Blight come off the Blight Card during Ravages that do 6+ overkill to the land. If that number ever exceeds players, the Invaders win.
loss_condition.note: Nature Incarnate wording (NI p.14), as the engine (Brett, Q18). Older Wiki text: 'Ravages that do 8+ Damage to the land'; same at land Health 2.

sources: Level titles and text: Steam engine defs (TheHabsburgMonarchy), icon tokens written as words, formatting tags removed. Cross-checked against data/references/rules/register.md section 4.5 (Wiki copy). Difficulty and fear decks: box panel values (Brett, 2026-10-19); fear deck = 3 per Terror Level plus the engine offsets. Levels are cumulative: level N applies levels 1..N. is_cliff is unset pending a strategy review.

levels.name: Base
levels.escalation: Escalation (Seek Prime Territory): After Exploring: On each board with 4 or fewer Blight, add 1 Town to a land without Town/Blight. On each board with 2 or fewer Blight, do so again. Additional loss condition (Irreparable Damage): Track how many Blight come off the Blight Card during Ravages that do 6+ overkill to the land. If that number ever exceeds players, the Invaders win.
levels.notes: R-ADV-HLC-L0a, R-ADV-HLC-L0b. Escalation happens after Exploring.

levels.name: Migratory Herders
levels.escalation: After the normal Build Step: In each land matching a Build Card, Gather 1 Town from a land not matching a Build Card. (In board/land order.)

levels.name: More Rural Than Urban
levels.escalation: During Setup, on each board, add 1 Town to land #2 and 1 Town to the highest-numbered land without Setup symbols. During Play, when Invaders would Build 1 City in an Inland land, they instead Build 2 Town.

levels.name: Fast Spread
levels.escalation: When making the Invader Deck, Remove 1 additional Stage I Card. (New deck order: 11-2222-33333)

levels.name: Herds Thrive in Verdant Lands
levels.escalation: Town in lands without Blight are Durable: they have +2 Health, and “Destroy Town” effects instead deal 2 Damage (to those Town only) per Town they could Destroy. (”Destroy all Town“ works normally.)

levels.name: Wave of Immigration
levels.escalation: Before the initial Explore, put the Habsburg Reminder Card under the top 5 Invader Cards. When revealed, on each board, add 1 City to a Coastal land without City and 1 Town to the 3 Inland lands with the fewest Blight.
levels.notes: R-ADV-HLC-L5a, R-ADV-HLC-L5b. Wiki ruling: resolve the Reminder Card after the Explore that turn.

levels.name: Far-Flung Herds
levels.escalation: Ravages do +2 Damage (total) if any adjacent lands have Town. (This does not cause lands without Invaders to Ravage.)
